text.feels_intro: How {name}'s frost bites feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a hand-sized patch of cheek or brow has gone stark white and stiff where the frost was held, ringed by angry red skin; a fine rime of frost clings to {his} lashes.

{name}'s face: the frost-nipped patches have swollen into tight, shiny red-violet skin, the tip of the nose and the ears waxy grey-white; small clear blisters are rising along the cheekbone, and {his} breath comes in short, misting puffs.

{name}'s face: the frozen skin has gone waxy and dead, mottled purple-black at the nose, ears and cheek and swollen with fat, blood-filled blisters; {his} lips are blue and the flesh looks like cold wax. A damp, faintly sweet smell of dying skin clings to {him}.
body: {name}'s back: blotches of stark white, frost-stiffened skin the size of a spread hand, each ringed in angry red, with gooseflesh all across {his} shoulders. {name} smells of cold sweat.

{name}'s back: the frozen patches have swollen into hard, shiny red-violet plaques between the shoulder blades, clear blisters rising at their centres and the skin around them mottled; {his} shoulders shake with shivers.

{name}'s back: broad swathes of waxy grey-white and purple-black frostbite, hard as cold leather and swollen with dark, blood-filled blisters; in places the skin has split and weeps. A damp, sickly-sweet smell of dying flesh clings to {him}.
arm: {name}'s {part}: a stark white, numb-looking patch on the forearm or upper arm where the frost was pressed, ringed by red; the fingers are pale and stiff.
{name}'s {part}: the frozen patch has swollen red-violet and shiny, small clear blisters rising across it; the fingers are puffy, white at the tips and slow to move.

{name}'s {part}: waxy grey-white skin darkening to purple-black, hard and cold as wax, with fat blood-filled blisters; the fingertips are blue-black and the hand is badly swollen. It gives off a damp, sickly-sweet smell of dying flesh.
leg: {name}'s {part}: a stark white, frost-stiffened patch on the thigh or calf, ringed by red, the skin around it pricked with gooseflesh.
{name}'s {part}: the frozen patch has swollen into a shiny red-violet plaque studded with clear blisters; the toes are pale and the leg is held stiffly.

{name}'s {part}: waxy grey-white flesh turning purple-black, hard and cold as wax and swollen with dark, blood-filled blisters; the foot is blue and badly swollen. A damp, sickly-sweet smell of dying flesh rises from it.

head: {name}'s face stings with a sharp, burning cold that turns to a prickling numbness, and {his} teeth chatter. {name} is shaken and humiliated, squinting and speaking through stiff, clumsy lips.

{name}'s face aches with a deep, gnawing cold under numb, wooden skin, and the swollen patches throb as feeling tries to return. {name} is frightened and resentful, shivering hard, speaking thickly and keeping {his} face turned away.

{name}'s face is a dead, heavy numbness shot through with deep, burning stabs where the flesh is dying, and {he} is shaking, sluggish and lightheaded. {name} is in shock, terrified or drifting, {his} words slurred and {his} jaw barely moving.
body: {name}'s back burns with a searing cold where the frost was held, then prickles into numbness, and shivers rack {his} shoulders. {name} is stunned and tense, hunched forward with {his} arms wrapped around {reflexive}.

{name}'s back aches deep with cold, the swollen patches throbbing and the blisters stinging whenever clothing brushes them. {name} is miserable and enduring it, shuddering and stiff, unable to lean back or straighten fully.

{name}'s back is heavy, wooden and numb, pierced by deep, burning stabs where the flesh is dying, and the shivering has become violent, uncontrollable shaking. {name} is helpless and close to collapse, sluggish and confused, barely able to hold {reflexive} upright.
arm: {name}'s {part} stings with a biting, burning cold that fades to a prickling numbness; the fingers are clumsy and slow. {name} is shaken, rubbing the arm and holding it close.

{name}'s {part} aches to the bone with cold, the swollen patch throbbing and the blisters stinging; {his} grip is weak and the fingers barely close. {name} is resentful and guarded, cradling the arm against {his} body and shivering.

{name}'s {part} is a dead, heavy numbness broken by deep, burning stabs where the flesh is dying, and the hand will not answer. {name} is terrified for the arm, in shock and shaking, unable to grip or move the fingers.
leg: {name}'s {part} stings with a burning cold that fades into prickling numbness, and the foot feels clumsy. {name} is shaken, shivering and stamping to bring the feeling back.
{name}'s {part} aches deep with cold, the swollen patch throbbing and the blisters stinging with every step, the toes numb. {name} is miserable and walks stiff-legged, unsure of {his} footing.

{name}'s {part} is a dead, wooden weight shot with deep, burning stabs where the flesh is dying, and {he} cannot feel the foot. {name} is panicked and exhausted, unable to trust the leg, stumbling or needing support.

head: {name}'s face feels normal, though it stings and goes numb faster than it should in the cold. A chill on {his} cheek brings back a quiet memory of the frost.
{name}'s face is tender, the new skin tight and oversensitive to wind and cold. {name} flinches when cold air or a cold hand comes near {his} face.

{name}'s face burns and itches as it thaws, a maddening pins and needles crawling under the peeling skin. {name} is irritable and self-conscious, rubbing at {his} cheeks and wincing at both warm air and cold drafts.
body: {name}'s back has its full movement again, but a cold wind across it makes {him} shiver harder than it should. The chill brings back a quiet memory of the frost held against {his} skin.
{name}'s back is tender and tight over the new skin and aches dully when {he} is chilled. {name} is wary of cold drafts and edges toward any fire.

{name}'s back burns and itches as it thaws, pins and needles crawling across the peeling skin, and every brush of cloth stings. {name} is weary and on edge, moving carefully and rolling {his} shoulders to ease the itch.
arm: {name}'s {part} has its full feeling and strength again; the fingers still go numb quickly in the cold, a quiet reminder of the frost.
{name}'s {part} is tender and tingles at the fingertips, aching in the cold. {name} keeps the hand tucked away or close to warmth.

{name}'s {part} burns and itches as it thaws, pins and needles crawling into the fingers, and the stiff joints ache when {he} bends them. {name} is frustrated, flexing {his} fingers and fumbling small tasks.
leg: {name}'s {part} has its full strength and feeling again; the foot aches and goes numb faster in the cold, a quiet reminder of the frost.
{name}'s {part} is tender and stiff in the cold, the toes tingling after long walks. {name} walks almost normally but stamps {his} feet often to keep them warm.
{name}'s {part} burns and itches as it thaws, pins and needles prickling down into the toes, and it throbs when {he} stands. {name} is weary of it, limping and rubbing the leg whenever {he} rests.

levels: , a sudden, searing cold pressed against bare skin. The frost bites like a hot iron before the numbness spreads, and {he} gasps, flinches and starts to shiver.
over skin already white and stinging. The cold drives deeper into the frost-nipped flesh, the numb patch flaring into a burning ache, and {his} teeth begin to chatter.

, and the cold sinks into swollen, blistered flesh that had barely begun to thaw. A burning stab cuts through the numbness and drags a strangled cry from {him} as violent shivers take {his} whole body.

, and it is too much. The cold reaches the dying flesh beneath the blisters: {his} lips go blue, {his} breath rattles in short, misting gasps, and {his} limbs shake, then grow sluggish and refuse to answer.

level.high: The new skin on {name}'s {parts} is toughening, with only a lingering sensitivity to cold left.
level.mid: The peeling skin on {name}'s {parts} has given way to thin, shiny pink new skin.
level.low: The frost bites on {name}'s {parts} have thawed; the skin is peeling and itches with pins and needles.

start_unhurt.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. With no wounds to mend, it simply feels warm and soothing.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s frost bites is gone, but the healing continues.
